description: Forward fuselage only; privately owned in southern Hamamatsu around 2004 and donated here about 2015
Formerly at the Osaka Modern Transportation Museum; wings and tail currently detached and stored beside the aircraft; being restored gradually
The oldest of three gliders shown to illustrate glider development; steel tube and fabric
All-metal glider in the three-generation display
The most modern of the three gliders; largely moulded plastic
